purpose: Human/AI cinematic curation overlay for the existing CURRENT. Does not change identity, Catalog or runtime capability.
coreRules: Choose a visual style family per sequence and do not mix incompatible high-saliency families in one frame.
Use FULL_FRAME_LOCATION/FULL_FRAME_ONLY layers as the base plate. Never place an opaque full-frame plate as a partial overlay.
Use PARALLAX_ONLY layers only as compatible background/midground/foreground overlays, never as the sole location plate.
EXCLUDE_DEFAULT handles remain legal CURRENT identities but must not be selected by default cinematic authoring.
Dialogue portraits belong to a dedicated Dialogue Stage/monitor/frame or a clean dialogue shot; never float raw portraits over a busy world-action frame.
In wide/extreme-wide shots, world humans should normally occupy roughly 0.12-0.28 of screen height; the current class default 0.48 is a medium/close fallback, not an establishing-shot target.
One frame should normally have one primary focal subject and at most one co-primary opponent/partner. Other visible elements are support/ambient.
Full-frame motion overlays (speed lines, vignette) fill the frame; local effects (impact, explosion, shield) stay actor-local and do not become giant rectangular inserts.
